summary: Wendy's adopted a stockholder rights plan on November 4, 2026, with a $37.00 per one-thousandth of a Series A Junior Participating Preferred Share purchase price, via a Rights Agreement with Equiniti Trust Company. The Record Date is November 16, 2026. Trian Fund Management-affiliated directors were excluded from the board vote. The plan responded to an October 28, 2026 unsolicited, non-binding proposal by Trian, Flynn Group, BlueFive Capital, and Sixth Street Partners to acquire all common shares not owned by the Investor Group for $7.35 per share. The rights intend to deter negative control without a premium and afford the board and independent committee time for informed judgment. Watch for a Schedule 13D amendment, further Investor Group communications, and whether the board engages on price.
